diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it passes in every rollout despite the decision-maker never having access to the private facts PF1 or PF2. The model is likely defaulting to a 'cautionary' stance (setting migration_approved to false and adding requirements for compatibility/cost controls) based on general safety heuristics rather than the specific hidden information.

The invoice review changes artifact retention from the draft's 90 days to exactly 30 days, changes the absent cost control to an alert at exactly $9,000 per month, requires a cost-control commitment, and contributes to the decision not to approve the draft.
